## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

Tile w=64, h=32. Screen of tile (x,y) center:

function nightFactor(h){

}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Indonesian city-builder game named **Kota Kita** with a TheoTown-inspired isometric style, where the player acts as mayor building a city from empty land to a metropolis.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game, not a mockup; no clarifying questions.
- Theme: TheoTown-like isometric city builder, Indonesian language.
- Player builds roads/zones, utilities, services, recreation, decorations; must include fun options/events/policies.
- Mobile responsive with touch support.
- Static HTML project served from repo root (no framework/build required).

## Decisions
- Pure static HTML/CSS/JS with Canvas 2D isometric renderer; no external assets/frameworks.
- Map: 24×24 tiles, procedural grass/lake/trees/rocks; starts empty.
- Zones (`zone_r`, `zone_c`, `zone_i`) grow automatically with road access + power + water + demand.
- Economy ticks every 1.5s; money, taxes, policies, maintenance, happiness, RCI demand.
- Missions guide progression; unlocks by `maxPop`; win at 1,000 population.
- Random city events with choices; policies/tax modal; save/load via localStorage key `kotakita.save.v2`.
- Animated day/night cycle, cars, ferris wheel, smoke, ambient sounds.
- Hidden debug API `window.KK.game` for automated screenshots/showcase (`.showcase()` now exists).
- Start screen uses separate animated hero world rendered with the same renderer.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`: full HUD, rail, catalog, side panel, timebar, start screen, SVG icon sprite.
- `styles.css`: complete desktop/mobile styling, panels, modals, start screen.
- `js/data.js`: all building definitions, categories, missions, policies, events, palettes.
- `js/render.js`: isometric primitives, terrain/roads, most building art, trees, utilities, services, parks, ferris, stadium, monument, thumbnails, night rendering, selection outline.
- `js/game.js`: map generation, placement/bulldoze, simulation, economy, growth, missions, unlocks, cars, UI, modals, policies, events, save/load, input, camera, loop, hero scene, boot, showcase.
- Game loads and runs; start screen and main HUD render; trees now visible; buildings/art render.

### Active
- Fixing catalog cards: `data-id="undefined"` because `DEFS` entries lack an `id` property, causing blank thumbnails and non-functional card clicks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. In `js/data.js`, add `DEFS[id].id = id` for every key before export (edit attempt failed because the text did not exist yet).
2. Reload and verify card thumbnails render and card clicks select tools.
3. Take gameplay screenshots; test road/zone/utilities placement, simulation growth, save/continue, policies, events.
4. Run `KK.game.showcase()` and inspect a mature-city screenshot for visual/layout bugs.
5. Test mobile viewport (~390×844): catalog bottom sheet, rail, topbar, touch placement, side panel.
6. Check console for remaining errors, especially `drawPlate` NaN issues (fixed by adding `gridSize`), and polish visuals/balance.
7. Update `README.md` with game instructions if time permits.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM structure and SVG icons.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all UI and responsive styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: defs/missions/policies/events; needs `def.id` fix now.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js`: Canvas 2D isometric renderer/art.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: state, simulation, UI, input, save/load, hero, boot, showcase.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/start.png`: latest start-screen screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/game1.png`, `game2.png`: gameplay HUD screenshots.
- `/tmp/kota-server.log`: running static server log.
- `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/console-*.log`: browser console errors.

## Important Context
- Static server is running on `http://localhost:3000` via `PORT=3000 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime bash start.sh`.
- Playwright CLI requires `--browser chrome` because expected Chromium build is missing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3000 --browser chrome`; set `DISPLAY=:$(cat ~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display)`, then `playwright-cli resize 1440 900`.
- Browser viewport is currently 1440×900; screenshots saved under `screenshots/`.
- Save data exists in browser localStorage, so reload shows “Lanjutkan kota tersimpan”; use `window.KK.game.continueGame()` or click through the overwrite confirmation.
- Critical earlier bugs fixed: missing `})(window.KK);` IIFE invocation in `game.js`, missing `state.gridSize`, invalid `'#889'` color, wrong `drawTree` call signature, `[hidden]` CSS override.
- Current exact issue: catalog card HTML shows `data-id="undefined"`; manually calling `KK.render.drawThumbnail(c, "zone_r")` works and produces pixels, confirming the renderer itself is fine.
- `KK.game` debug methods: `startNew`, `continueGame`, `loadGame`, `saveGame`, `tick(n)`, `placeAt`, `forcePlace`, `bulldozeAt`, `setTool`, `showPolicies`, `showHelp`, `showWin`, `showRandomEvent`, `showcase`.
- `KK.game.showcase()` builds a large demo city at “Kota Nusantara” with all landmarks/services and sets money/pop/time; useful for screenshots, but may overlap roads/water in a few places and needs visual checking.
- No files have been committed; all work is uncommitted in the working tree.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the playable Indonesian city-builder **Kota Kita**, with an isometric style inspired by TheoTown.
- Finish quality assurance and polish the existing static HTML/CSS/JS game.

## Requirements
- Complete game, not a mockup; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Indonesian-language city-building gameplay with roads, zones, utilities, services, recreation, decorations, events, and policies.
- Responsive mobile layout with touch support; static project served from the repository root.

## Decisions
- Use a pure static HTML/CSS/JS project and Canvas 2D isometric renderer, with no external assets or framework.
- Use a 24×24 procedural map, simulation/economy, missions and unlocks, events and policies, and localStorage save/load.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed catalog cards using `DEFS[id].id`; verified cards render thumbnails across all categories and clicking a zone card selects its tool.
- Fixed road thumbnail rendering and catalog canvas sizing/aspect ratio.
- Added an inline SVG favicon to prevent the prior favicon 404.
- Smoke-tested building placement, simulation ticks, and the showcase city; inspected screenshots of the start screen, gameplay, showcase, mobile layout, policies, events, and win modal.
- Changes remain uncommitted.

### Active
- Finish gameplay and responsive QA, especially save/continue, placement constraints, utility coverage, growth, policy/event choices, and touch placement.
- Update `README.md` with game instructions and polish any issues found during final checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test a fresh city through roads, zones, utilities, growth, and service placement; verify simulation and placement constraints.
2. Test save/continue, policy and event choices, and touch placement at a mobile viewport around 390×844.
3. Review any remaining visual issues and console output; note canvas `getImageData` performance warnings if they persist.
4. Add concise player instructions to `README.md`, then report the final state and tests.

## Relevant Files
- `js/data.js`: building definitions, missions, policies, events; definition IDs are now assigned before export.
- `js/render.js`: isometric renderer and corrected road/catalog thumbnails.
- `js/game.js`: simulation, placement, UI, save/load, events, and showcase/debug API.
- `index.html`: game interface and inline favicon.
- `styles.css`: HUD, catalog, modals, and responsive layout.
- `README.md`: currently generic project README; instructions remain to be added.
- `screenshots/`: visual QA screenshots, including `showcase2.png`, `mobile1.png`, `policies1.png`, `event2.png`, and `win1.png`.

## Important Context
- Static server was available at `http://localhost:3000`.
- `window.KK.game.showcase()` creates a mature demo city; debug helpers include `startNew`, `continueGame`, `placeAt`, `forcePlace`, `tick`, `showPolicies`, and `showRandomEvent`.
- The browser QA found no JavaScript errors; earlier favicon 404 was addressed. Canvas `getImageData` performance warnings were observed.

## Objective
- Complete and polish the playable Indonesian city-builder **Kota Kita**, inspired by TheoTown, and finish gameplay/responsive QA.

## Requirements
- Deliver a complete static HTML/CSS/JavaScript game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Include Indonesian city-building gameplay and responsive mobile/touch support.

## Decisions
- Use a pure static project with a Canvas 2D isometric renderer, procedural 24×24 map, simulation, missions, policies, events, and localStorage saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed catalog cards and road thumbnails, added an inline SVG favicon, and previously inspected gameplay and showcase screenshots.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax checks pass and browser console reports no errors or warnings.
- Browser-smoke-tested a fresh city: placed roads, a residential zone, power and water utilities; advanced simulation to population 6; saved and loaded successfully.
- Tested policy/tax changes and an event choice; verified the event modal closed and the city save remained available.
- Checked the 390×844 mobile layout: game canvas, HUD, rail, catalog, and time controls fit without page overflow.

### Active
- Finish touch-placement QA and review any remaining visual issues.
- Replace the generic `README.md` with concise game instructions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test touch placement on the mobile viewport and inspect the final browser console/visual state.
2. Add player instructions and run final checks.
3. Report the final state and tests; work remains uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game interface and static entry point.
- `js/game.js`: simulation, placement, save/load, policies, events, and QA helpers.
- `js/render.js`: isometric renderer.
- `js/data.js`: building definitions, missions, policies, and events.
- `styles.css`: responsive layout and game styling.
- `README.md`: generic README; needs game instructions.
- `screenshots/`: prior visual QA captures.

## Important Context
- Static server responds at `http://localhost:3000`.
- Browser QA helpers are available under `window.KK.game`, including `startNew`, `continueGame`, `placeAt`, `tick`, `showPolicies`, and `showRandomEvent`.
- The save key is `kotakita.save.v2`.

# Kota Kita

**Kota Kita** is a browser-based Indonesian city-building game. Plan roads and zones, provide utilities and public services, balance the city budget, and grow your town into a metropolis.

## Play

Serve the files from this folder with any static web server, then open its address in a browser. For example, with Python installed:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3000
```

Open <http://localhost:3000>. No build step or external packages are required.

## How to play

1. Start a new city and choose its name (or continue a saved city).
2. Build roads to connect future developments; buildings need road access.
3. Zone residential, commercial, and industrial land alongside roads.
4. Provide electricity and water so residents can move in, and add services and parks to improve city life.
5. Manage taxes and policies, respond to city events, complete missions, and work toward a population of 1,000.

### Controls

- **Desktop:** choose a category and building from the side panels, then click a map tile to build. Drag the map to pan and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
- **Touchscreen:** choose a category and building, then tap a tile. Drag to pan and pinch to zoom.
- Use the in-game help button for a guided introduction. The toolbar also includes save, sound, and city-statistics controls.

Cities are saved in the browser's local storage. Use the in-game save button to save manually; the game also saves automatically as you play.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e59d24154ffeVeMY5qGKK6EACq" state="completed">
## Findings

The game is currently **24 × 24 by design**, not just by its starting-map setting. Several gameplay and persistence paths still rely on a fixed `GRID` constant, so changing only the initial map size or the renderer would leave inconsistent behavior.

- **Grid constant and initial state:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js:3`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js) defines `GRID = 24`. [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js:3`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js) captures it; `blankState()` at lines 99–114 initializes `gridSize` from it.
- **Gameplay indexing and bounds:** Fixed-`GRID` assumptions appear in `game.js` at lines 61–63, 214, 297, 440, 777–805, 1011, 1045, 1068–1071, and 1272–1279. These cover grid access and bounds, road counts, minimap handling, persistence, camera clamps, and minimap clicks.
- **Terrain generation and initial camera:** `generateMap()` at `game.js:116–150` uses fixed-size loops and fixed coordinates for its lake, pond, and clearing. Initial camera placement is at lines 153–168.
- **Rendering:** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js:125–148, 208–217, 457–480`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js) already uses `world.gridSize` for the map plate, tile loops, and terrain-neighbor checks. This is a useful foundation, though gameplay and save/load still need to agree with it.
- **Save/load:** `game.js:7, 1009–1059` uses save version `v: 2` and key `kotakita.save.v2`. Terrain is stored as a flat string; road positions are encoded as `y * GRID + x`; loading reconstructs exactly `GRID * GRID` tiles. These encodings cannot safely represent variable-size maps without a dimension-aware format.
- **Minimap:** The canvas is 260 × 260 at [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:93–95`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html). Its drawing logic assumes `GRID` at `game.js:783–784`, and click-to-world conversion hardcodes 260/10 at lines 1274–1277. The markup’s initial `24 × 24` badge is not a dependable size display: `updateHUD` replaces it with population at `game.js:719`.
- **UI locations:** Top actions are at `index.html:66–71`; the city summary side panel is at lines 86–126. The build rail/catalog is at lines 74–84, with responsive positioning in [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css:65–95, 312–367`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css). On mobile, the side panel is hidden unless opened (`styles.css:318–326`).

## Recommended minimal design

1. **Make `state.gridSize` the single source of truth.** Use it for indexing, bounds checks, loops, road encoding, camera limits, minimap scaling/click conversion, and save/load. Keep `GRID` as the *default starting size* only; avoid using it as a stride or runtime boundary after initialization.
2. **Treat expansion as growth of the existing map.** On purchase, increase `gridSize`, allocate the larger grid, and copy existing tiles and road/building data to the same `(x, y)` coordinates. Generate terrain only for newly added cells, using the new bounds and avoiding hardcoded features that assume a 24 × 24 map. This preserves existing city layouts.
3. **Version the save representation for dimensions.** Add the map size to the saved data and use that size when flattening and reconstructing terrain and road positions. Keep a legacy loading path for v2: interpret those saves as 24 × 24, then allow them to be saved in the newer format. This avoids silently loading old terrain or roads with the wrong stride.
4. **Update the minimap and expansion UI.** Derive cell size and click mapping from canvas dimensions and `gridSize`, rather than the current 260/10 constants. Show map dimensions in a dedicated size label. A purchase action can fit in the top actions or city summary panel; make sure it remains accessible on mobile, where the side panel may be hidden.
5. **Leave rendering’s existing size-aware paths intact** and verify their callers pass the expanded state consistently.

## Suggested implementation checklist

- Search `game.js` for remaining uses of `GRID`; classify each as a legitimate default or a runtime assumption, then replace runtime assumptions with `state.gridSize`.
- Check terrain generation at both the original size and after expansion, including feature placement and newly generated cells.
- Confirm buildings, roads, terrain, and selected coordinates retain their positions after a purchase.
- Verify camera movement and clamps at each edge of the expanded map.
- Verify minimap rendering and clicks across the entire expanded map.
- Test loading a v2 save as 24 × 24, expanding it, saving, and reloading without loss or shifted roads/terrain.
- Check the expansion control and size display at desktop and mobile layouts.

## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**.
- Tambahkan fitur untuk memperluas kota.

## Requirements
- Game statis, berbahasa Indonesia, mendukung gameplay city-building dan kontrol mobile/touch.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.

## Decisions
- `GRID = 24` tetap menjadi ukuran peta awal; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta lama, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- QA sebelumnya mencakup syntax JavaScript, simulasi dasar, save/load, kebijakan/event, dan layout mobile; screenshot ada di `screenshots/mobile-touch-qa.png`.
- `README.md` berisi instruksi bermain dan menjalankan server statis.
- `js/game.js` sudah memakai ukuran runtime pada indexing, batas penempatan, penghitungan jalan, dan daftar jalan.
- `expandCity()` sudah menyalin petak ke grid lebih besar, memotong biaya, menghitung ulang kota, memperbarui UI, membatasi kamera, dan menyimpan.
- HUD menampilkan ukuran kota dan berupaya memperbarui tombol ekspansi jika `#expandBtn` tersedia.

### Active
- Selesaikan minimap dan klik minimap dengan ukuran/offset konsisten.
- Simpan dan muat `gridSize` serta indeks jalan dengan stride dinamis, sambil mendukung save lama tanpa `gridSize`.
- Tambahkan tombol ekspansi di `index.html`, styling responsif di `styles.css`, dan event handler ke `expandCity()`.
- Ubah batas kamera agar mengikuti ukuran peta runtime.
- Jalankan QA ekspansi, kompatibilitas save, minimap, kamera, serta tampilan desktop/mobile.

### Blocked
- `updateMinimap()` menghitung `padX`/`padY`, tetapi menggambar petak dan marker masih memakai variabel `pad` yang tidak didefinisikan; perlu diperbaiki sebelum QA.

## Next Move
1. Perbaiki posisi gambar minimap dan marker; sesuaikan klik minimap terhadap ukuran dinamis.
2. Tambahkan `gridSize` ke serialisasi dan gunakan stride grid dinamis saat load; fallback save lama ke 24×24.
3. Tambahkan kontrol ekspansi dan event handler, lalu ubah batas kamera ke `state.gridSize`.
4. Jalankan pengujian ekspansi, save/load lama dan baru, minimap, kamera, serta layout mobile dan desktop.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, ukuran grid runtime, HUD, minimap, kamera, dan save/load.
- `index.html`: panel kota dan tempat tombol ekspansi.
- `styles.css`: styling responsif kontrol ekspansi.
- `js/render.js`: renderer memakai `world.gridSize`.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `README.md`: instruksi bermain dan menjalankan game.

## Important Context
- Save memakai key `kotakita.save.v2`; format lama tidak menyimpan ukuran grid, dan indeks jalan lama memakai stride 24.
- Perubahan ekspansi belum selesai dan belum diuji; perubahan repo belum di-commit.

## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk fitur perluasan kota.
- Pertahankan save lama dan dukungan gameplay mobile/touch.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal tetap `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan minimap, kamera, serialisasi save v2, pemuatan save lama, dan tombol perluasan di `js/game.js`.
- Tombol perluasan dan styling responsif ditambahkan di `index.html` dan `styles.css`.
- `node --check js/game.js`, `node --check js/render.js`, dan `git diff --check` berhasil.
- QA browser: game dimulai pada 24×24 dengan kas $6.000; ekspansi pertama berhasil ke 32×32, kas menjadi $3.500, terrain terserialisasi 1.024 petak, dan save tersimpan dengan `gridSize: 32`.

### Active
- QA perluasan berulang hingga 64×64, biaya/batas kas, save/load, kompatibilitas save lama, minimap, kamera, dan layout desktop/mobile.
- Perlu menyiapkan save uji berkas kas besar tanpa reload halaman game aktif, karena `beforeunload` menyimpan ulang kas saat ini dan menimpa perubahan localStorage.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Lanjutkan QA dari browser yang saat ini membuka `http://127.0.0.1:3002/README.md`; manipulasi save uji dari halaman itu, lalu kembali ke game dan pilih lanjutkan.
2. Uji biaya bertahap sampai batas 64×64, serta muat ulang save kota yang diperluas.
3. Uji migrasi save lama tanpa `gridSize`, minimap dan navigasi klik, batas kamera, serta tampilan desktop/mobile; perbaiki temuan.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: perluasan kota, minimap, kamera, save/load, dan event tombol.
- `index.html`: tombol ekspansi di panel kota.
- `styles.css`: styling responsif tombol ekspansi dan panel minimap.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia memakai `gridSize`.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `README.md`: instruksi bermain dan halaman yang dipakai sementara untuk menyiapkan save uji.

## Important Context
- Save key tetap `kotakita.save.v2`; save lama tidak memiliki `gridSize` dan menggunakan indeks jalan dengan stride 24.
- Ekspansi 24→32 berhasil dan tombol menjadi nonaktif pada kas $3.500 karena ekspansi berikutnya memerlukan $8.000.
- Perubahan belum di-commit.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk fitur perluasan kota.
- Pertahankan kompatibilitas save lama dan dukungan mobile/touch.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan tombol perluasan di `js/game.js`; UI tombol dan styling responsif di `index.html` dan `styles.css`.
- QA ekspansi berulang sampai 64×64: biaya $2.500, $8.000, $13.500, $19.000, dan $24.500; tombol batas tercapai pada 64×64.
- QA save/load kota 64×64; ukuran dan terrain 4.096 petak tetap tersimpan.
- QA migrasi save lama tanpa `gridSize`: dimuat sebagai 24×24, jalan pada indeks stride 24 dan terrain dipertahankan; ekspansi berikutnya memetakan jalan ke stride 32 dan mempertahankan terrain lama.
- QA klik minimap untuk navigasi kamera serta layout desktop 1280×800 dan mobile 390×844; tidak ditemukan horizontal overflow.
- `node --check js/game.js`, `node --check js/render.js`, dan `git diff --check` berhasil.
- Perubahan belum di-commit.

### Active
- QA akhir batas kamera dan kontrol touch; screenshot desktop/mobile tersedia tetapi belum ditinjau secara visual.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Lanjutkan QA kamera di batas peta dan kontrol touch pada viewport mobile.
2. Tinjau screenshot desktop/mobile, perbaiki temuan, lalu jalankan ulang pemeriksaan akhir.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, kamera, minimap, save/load, input.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia dengan ukuran runtime.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `index.html`: tombol ekspansi dan panel kota.
- `styles.css`: layout responsif panel ekspansi/minimap.
- `README.md`: instruksi bermain.

## Important Context
- Save key `kotakita.save.v2`; save lama tidak memiliki `gridSize` dan memakai indeks jalan dengan stride 24.
- Browser saat ini membuka game pada 1280×800; localStorage berisi save uji hasil migrasi lalu ekspansi ke 32×32, dua jalan uji, dan kas yang terpengaruh simulasi berjalan.
- Screenshot QA: `/tmp/opencode/kotakita-mobile.png` dan `/tmp/opencode/kotakita-desktop.png`.

## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk perluasan kota.
- Pertahankan kompatibilitas save lama dan dukungan mobile/touch.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan tombol perluasan di `js/game.js`; UI tombol dan styling responsif di `index.html` dan `styles.css`.
- QA ekspansi berulang hingga 64×64, termasuk biaya dan status batas; QA save/load 64×64.
- QA migrasi save lama tanpa `gridSize` sebagai 24×24, lalu ekspansi ke 32×32 dengan terrain dan jalan lama tetap terpetakan.
- QA navigasi minimap di batas peta, kontrol touch untuk pan dan pinch-zoom, serta layout mobile 390×844 tanpa horizontal overflow.
- Tinjauan screenshot desktop dan mobile; UI terlihat baik.
- `node --check js/game.js`, `node --check js/render.js`, `git diff --check`, dan pemeriksaan console browser berhasil.

- (none)

1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, kamera, minimap, save/load, input.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia dengan ukuran runtime.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `index.html`: tombol ekspansi dan panel kota.
- `styles.css`: layout responsif panel ekspansi/minimap.
- `README.md`: instruksi bermain.

- Save key `kotakita.save.v2`; save lama tidak memiliki `gridSize` dan memakai indeks jalan dengan stride 24.

1: # Kota Kita
2: 
3: **Kota Kita** is a browser-based Indonesian city-building game. Plan roads and zones, provide utilities and public services, balance the city budget, and grow your town into a metropolis.
4: 
5: ## Play
6: 
7: Serve the files from this folder with any static web server, then open its address in a browser. For example, with Python installed:
8: 
9: ```bash
10: python3 -m http.server 3000
11: ```
12: 
13: Open <http://localhost:3000>. No build step or external packages are required.
14: 
15: ## How to play
16: 
17: 1. Start a new city and choose its name (or continue a saved city).
18: 2. Build roads to connect future developments; buildings need road access.
19: 3. Zone residential, commercial, and industrial land alongside roads.
20: 4. Provide electricity and water so residents can move in, and add services and parks to improve city life.
21: 5. Manage taxes and policies, respond to city events, complete missions, and work toward a population of 1,000.
22: 
23: ### Controls
24: 
25: - **Desktop:** choose a category and building from the side panels, then click a map tile to build. Drag the map to pan and use the mouse wheel to zoom.
26: - **Touchscreen:** choose a category and building, then tap a tile. Drag to pan and pinch to zoom.
27: - Use the in-game help button for a guided introduction. The toolbar also includes save, sound, and city-statistics controls.
28: 
29: Cities are saved in the browser's local storage. Use the in-game save button to save manually; the game also saves automatically as you play.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita** dengan ekspansi kota dan UI modern bergaya glassmorphism yang dinamis.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.
- UI glassmorphism modern dan dinamis; dukungan mobile/touch tetap dijaga.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan dukungan touch; QA ekspansi hingga 64×64, migrasi save lama, save/load, serta layout mobile.
- Tema glassmorphism ditambahkan untuk HUD, panel, kontrol, layar awal, dan modal, termasuk fallback tanpa `backdrop-filter` dan pengurangan animasi.
- Pemeriksaan sintaks JavaScript dan `git diff --check` berhasil; tangkapan layar pasca-perubahan diambil pada desktop dan mobile.

### Active
- QA fungsional dan pemeriksaan visual lanjutan setelah perubahan glassmorphism.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Periksa tampilan serta interaksi dalam game pada desktop dan mobile; koreksi jika blur, kontras, atau tata letak terganggu.

## Relevant Files
- `styles.css`: tema glassmorphism dan layout responsif.
- `index.html`: struktur HUD, panel, layar awal, dan modal.
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, save/load, kamera, minimap, dan input.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia dengan ukuran runtime.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `README.md`: instruksi bermain.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-start/final-desktop.png`: tangkapan layar layar awal desktop pasca-perubahan.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-start/final-mobile.png`: tangkapan layar layar awal mobile pasca-perubahan.

## Important Context
- Perubahan belum di-commit; status sebelumnya menunjukkan `README.md` berubah dan `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, serta `styles.css` belum dilacak.
- QA sebelum perubahan visual sudah mencakup pemeriksaan konsol browser, ekspansi/save-load, dan layout mobile; QA fungsional pasca-perubahan visual belum dilakukan.
- Pemeriksaan pasca-perubahan yang berhasil: `node --check js/game.js`, `node --check js/render.js`, `node --check js/data.js`, dan `git diff --check`.
- Layar awal berhasil ditangkap pada viewport desktop 1440×900 dan mobile 390×844; server statis tersedia di `http://127.0.0.1:3002/`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita** dengan ekspansi kota dan UI modern bergaya glassmorphism yang dinamis.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.
- UI glassmorphism modern dan dinamis; dukungan mobile/touch tetap dijaga.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Perluasan menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, dengan batas 64×64.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan dukungan touch; QA fungsional sebelumnya mencakup ekspansi hingga 64×64, migrasi save lama, save/load, dan layout mobile.
- Tema glassmorphism ditambahkan untuk HUD, panel, kontrol, layar awal, dan modal, termasuk fallback tanpa `backdrop-filter` dan pengurangan animasi.
- QA gameplay terbaru pada desktop 1440×900 dan mobile 390×844: permainan dimulai, panel kota mobile dapat dibuka, tidak ada error JavaScript atau overflow halaman; tangkapan layar telah dibuat.

### Active
- QA lanjutan untuk interaksi kategori pembangunan dan katalog pada mobile, serta meninjau detail tata letak/teks HUD mobile.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Uji tap kategori dan pemilihan bangunan pada mobile; koreksi jika katalog, kontras, atau tata letaknya bermasalah.
2. Selesaikan QA visual/interaksi desktop dan mobile; perubahan kode belum dibuat untuk QA terbaru.

## Relevant Files
- `styles.css`: tema glassmorphism dan layout responsif.
- `index.html`: struktur HUD, panel, layar awal, dan modal.
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, save/load, kamera, minimap, dan input.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia dengan ukuran runtime.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-game-qa.mjs`: skrip QA gameplay desktop/mobile.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-game/game-desktop.png`: tangkapan layar gameplay desktop.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-game/game-mobile.png`: tangkapan layar gameplay mobile.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-game/game-mobile-panel.png`: tangkapan layar panel kota mobile terbuka.

## Important Context
- `node --check` untuk `js/game.js`, `js/render.js`, dan `js/data.js`, serta `git diff --check` sebelumnya berhasil.
- Server `http://127.0.0.1:3002/` tersedia saat QA terbaru.
- Perubahan belum di-commit; status terakhir: `README.md` berubah, sedangkan `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, dan `styles.css` belum dilacak.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita** dengan ekspansi kota dan UI modern bergaya glassmorphism.
- Mempertahankan pengalaman berbahasa Indonesia dan dukungan mobile/touch.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.
- Ekspansi kota menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, hingga 64×64.
- UI glassmorphism modern dan dinamis; dukungan mobile/touch tetap dijaga.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan dukungan touch; QA fungsional sebelumnya mencakup ekspansi hingga 64×64, migrasi save lama, save/load, dan layout mobile.
- Tema glassmorphism untuk HUD, panel, kontrol, layar awal, dan modal, termasuk fallback tanpa `backdrop-filter` dan pengurangan animasi.
- QA interaksi kategori dan pemilihan bangunan desktop/mobile: semua kategori berfungsi, pilihan aktif tampil, tidak ada error JavaScript atau overflow halaman.

### Active
- Meninjau detail tata letak/teks HUD mobile dan menyelesaikan QA visual desktop/mobile.
- Teks tanggal pada HUD mobile terlihat terpotong di screenshot (`Walikota Baru • Minggu 1, (`).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Perbaiki atau rapikan tampilan tanggal HUD mobile yang terpotong.
2. Selesaikan QA visual/interaksi desktop dan mobile; belum ada perubahan kode dari QA interaksi terbaru.

## Relevant Files
- `styles.css`: tema glassmorphism, layout responsif, dan aturan HUD mobile.
- `index.html`: struktur HUD, panel, layar awal, dan modal.
- `js/game.js`: ekspansi, save/load, kamera, minimap, dan input.
- `js/render.js`: renderer dunia dengan ukuran runtime.
- `js/data.js`: konstanta ukuran awal `GRID = 24`.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-game-interaction-qa.mjs`: skrip QA interaksi kategori dan katalog.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-game/category-mobile.png`: screenshot katalog kategori Utilitas di mobile.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-game-qa.mjs`: skrip QA gameplay desktop/mobile.
- `/tmp/opencode/glass-qa-game/`: screenshot gameplay desktop/mobile dan panel kota mobile.

## Important Context
- QA interaksi selesai tanpa error; seluruh kategori dapat ditap dan bangunan yang tersedia dapat dipilih.
- `node --check` untuk `js/game.js`, `js/render.js`, dan `js/data.js`, serta `git diff --check` sebelumnya berhasil.
- Server `http://127.0.0.1:3002/` tersedia saat QA.
- Perubahan belum di-commit; status terakhir: `README.md` berubah, sedangkan `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, dan `styles.css` belum dilacak.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Selesaikan game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita** dengan ekspansi kota dan UI glassmorphism responsif.
- Integrasikan periode simulasi harian/mingguan/bulanan dan kecepatan waktu, termasuk penyimpanan serta pemuatan pengaturan.

## Requirements
- Game statis dan berbahasa Indonesia; tetap mendukung mobile/touch.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat.
- Ekspansi kota menambah 8 petak pada lebar dan tinggi, mempertahankan isi peta, hingga 64×64.
- Periode dan kecepatan dapat diatur, disimpan, dan dimuat; save v2 lama memakai default kompatibel.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Biaya perluasan: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.
- Periode simulasi menentukan panjang satu langkah: harian = 1 hari, mingguan = 7 hari, bulanan = 30 hari.
- Ekonomi, pertumbuhan, peluruhan mood, waktu, dan timer event diskalakan terhadap durasi periode; angka pendapatan/biaya HUD tetap ditampilkan per minggu.
- Waktu kalender disimpan sebagai `elapsedDays`, sehingga nomor periode tetap konsisten saat pilihan periode berubah.
- Save v2 lama dimuat sebagai mingguan, kecepatan 1×, dan `elapsedDays = tick * 7`.
- Pada mobile, tanggal HUD berada di baris kedua di bawah jabatan wali kota.

## Work State
### Completed
- Perbaikan ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, dan dukungan touch; QA sebelumnya mencakup ekspansi hingga 64×64, migrasi save lama, save/load, serta layout mobile.
- Tema glassmorphism responsif dengan fallback tanpa `backdrop-filter` dan pengurangan animasi.
- QA interaksi kategori dan pemilihan bangunan desktop/mobile, termasuk clipping tanggal HUD mobile.
- Kontrol pemilih periode ditambahkan ke timebar; periode dan kecepatan diintegrasikan ke simulasi serta save/load.
- Pemeriksaan sintaks `node --check js/game.js` berhasil.

### Active
- QA integrasi periode, kecepatan, save/load save v2 lama, dan tampilan desktop/mobile.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Jalankan simulasi harian, mingguan, dan bulanan; verifikasi perubahan tanggal, ekonomi, pertumbuhan, dan event.
2. Uji simpan/muat periode serta kecepatan, termasuk migrasi save v2 lama tanpa pengaturan baru.
3. Periksa timebar pada desktop dan viewport mobile kecil.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: state, `simulateTick()`, periode/tanggal, ekonomi, event, kecepatan, save/load, dan HUD.
- `index.html`: HUD dan timebar dengan pemilih periode.
- `styles.css`: styling timebar dan kontrol responsif.

## Important Context
- Simulasi berjalan setiap 1,5 detik pada kecepatan 1×; tersedia 1×, 2×, dan 3×.
- Perubahan belum dikomit; status Git terakhir menunjukkan `README.md` berubah dan `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, serta `styles.css` belum dilacak.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk ekspansi kota, simulasi periode/kecepatan, dan UI responsif.
- Perbaiki desain combobox periode dan kesan simulasi terlalu cepat, lalu rombak glassmorphism agar terasa lebih realistis seperti liquid glass.

## Requirements
- Game statis, berbahasa Indonesia, tetap mendukung mobile/touch.
- Save v2 lama berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat; ekspansi menambah 8 petak per sisi hingga 64×64.
- Periode dan kecepatan harus berfungsi serta tersimpan/dimuat.
- Desain combobox waktu ditingkatkan dan tema liquid glass diterapkan pada game.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Biaya ekspansi: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.
- Harian/mingguan/bulanan masing-masing memajukan 1/7/30 hari per langkah; skala ekonomi dan simulasi lain menyesuaikan durasi periode.
- Kecepatan tersedia 1×, 2×, 3×; save lama memakai mingguan, 1×, dan `elapsedDays = tick * 7`.
- Kalender menghitung periode dari `elapsedDays`; tanggal HUD mobile berada di baris kedua.

## Work State
### Completed
- Ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, touch, dan UI responsif/glassmorphism awal.
- Kontrol periode dan kecepatan terhubung ke simulasi serta save/load.
- QA integrasi: skala ekonomi, mood, dan timer event sesuai; save/load dan migrasi save lama berhasil; timebar tidak overflow pada desktop 1280×800 dan mobile 360×640.
- `node --check js/game.js`, `js/render.js`, dan `js/data.js` berhasil.

### Active
- Desain ulang combobox periode.
- Selidiki dan perbaiki kesan waktu simulasi terlalu cepat/tidak berubah saat periode diganti.
- Rombak visual glassmorphism menjadi liquid glass yang lebih realistis.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Periksa alur waktu di `js/game.js`: `periodSelect` mengubah `state.period`, sedangkan `loop()` menjalankan langkah tiap 1,5 detik dikalikan `state.speed`; tentukan perilaku waktu yang diinginkan agar pergantian periode terasa jelas dan tidak terlalu cepat.
2. Implementasikan combobox periode yang lebih menarik dan mudah dipakai, termasuk mobile/touch.
3. Perbarui tema glassmorphism di `styles.css` ke gaya liquid glass yang konsisten, lalu uji ulang layout desktop/mobile dan simulasi.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: periode, kecepatan, `simulateTick()`, loop simulasi, save/load, HUD.
- `index.html`: markup combobox periode dan timebar.
- `styles.css`: styling timebar, combobox, responsif, dan glassmorphism.
- `/tmp/opencode/qa-kotakita-stable.mjs`: skrip QA browser untuk skala simulasi, save/load, dan layout.

## Important Context
- Perubahan belum dikomit; `README.md` berubah dan `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, serta `styles.css` belum dilacak.
- QA menampilkan label periode berganti setelah satu langkah (misalnya `Hari 2`); skala ekonomi dan timer terukur benar. Namun, pengguna masih merasakan waktu terlalu cepat/tidak berubah, dan perbaikannya belum dikerjakan.

## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk ekspansi kota, simulasi periode/kecepatan, dan UI responsif.
- Buat kontrol waktu lebih jelas dan nyaman, serta poles tema glassmorphism menjadi liquid glass.

## Requirements
- Game statis, berbahasa Indonesia, tetap mendukung mobile/touch.
- Save v2 berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat; ekspansi menambah 8 petak per sisi hingga 64×64.
- Periode dan kecepatan berfungsi serta tersimpan/dimuat.
- Kontrol periode ditingkatkan untuk desktop dan mobile/touch; waktu simulasi harus terasa jelas dan tidak terlalu cepat.
- Tema liquid glass diterapkan secara konsisten pada game.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Biaya ekspansi: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.
- Harian/mingguan/bulanan masing-masing memajukan 1/7/30 hari per langkah; skala ekonomi dan simulasi menyesuaikan durasi periode.
- Kecepatan tersedia 1×, 2×, 3×; save lama memakai mingguan, 1×, dan `elapsedDays = tick * 7`.
- Kalender menghitung periode dari `elapsedDays`; tanggal HUD mobile berada di baris kedua.
- Pacing langkah kini dirancang memakai `BASE_TICK_SECONDS = 2.4` dan interval periode `2.4 * (1 + .2 * Math.log2(days))`; kecepatan tetap mengalikan akumulator simulasi.

## Work State
### Completed
- Ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, touch, dan UI responsif/glassmorphism awal.
- Kontrol periode dan kecepatan terhubung ke simulasi serta save/load.
- QA integrasi terdahulu: skala ekonomi, mood, timer event, save/load, migrasi save lama, dan layout timebar desktop 1280×800/mobile 360×640.
- Perubahan terbaru: penyesuaian interval simulasi, mempertahankan progres langkah saat periode diganti, styling dasar kontrol periode, serta markup progress bar waktu.

### Active
- Selesaikan desain kontrol periode dan progress waktu; uji layout mobile/desktop.
- Rombak tema visual menjadi liquid glass yang lebih realistis dan konsisten.
- Validasi perubahan pacing baru dan pastikan simulasi serta kontrol tetap berfungsi.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Lengkapi styling liquid glass dan progress bar di `styles.css`, termasuk perilaku mobile.
2. Jalankan `node --check` untuk JavaScript dan QA browser untuk pacing, periode, save/load, serta overflow desktop/mobile.
3. Perbaiki masalah yang ditemukan dan tinjau perubahan akhir.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: periode, kecepatan, pacing, `simulateTick()`, loop simulasi, save/load, HUD.
- `index.html`: markup timebar, pemilih periode, progress bar.
- `styles.css`: timebar, layout responsif, dan tema glassmorphism/liquid glass.
- `/tmp/opencode/qa-kotakita-stable.mjs`: skrip QA browser integrasi sebelumnya.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Selesaikan dan poles game city-builder Indonesia **Kota Kita**, termasuk simulasi waktu, penyimpanan, dan UI liquid glass yang responsif.

## Requirements
- Game statis, berbahasa Indonesia, mendukung mobile/touch.
- Save v2 berukuran 24×24 tetap dapat dimuat; ekspansi menambah 8 petak per sisi hingga 64×64.
- Periode dan kecepatan berfungsi serta tersimpan/dimuat; simulasi tidak terasa terlalu cepat.
- Tema liquid glass diterapkan secara konsisten.

## Decisions
- Ukuran awal `GRID = 24`; ukuran runtime memakai `state.gridSize`.
- Biaya ekspansi: `2500 + ((gridSize - 24) / 8) * 5500`.
- Harian/mingguan/bulanan memajukan 1/7/30 hari per langkah; skala ekonomi dan simulasi menyesuaikan durasi periode.
- Kecepatan 1×, 2×, 3×; save lama memakai mingguan, 1×, dan `elapsedDays = tick * 7`.
- Kalender dihitung dari `elapsedDays`; tanggal HUD mobile berada di baris kedua.
- Pacing: `BASE_TICK_SECONDS = 2.4`, `tickInterval() = 2.4 * (1 + .2 * Math.log2(days))`; kecepatan mengalikan akumulator simulasi.

## Work State
### Completed
- Ekspansi peta, minimap, kamera, serialisasi/muat save v2, touch, dan UI responsif.
- Kontrol periode/kecepatan tersambung ke simulasi dan save/load.
- CSS liquid glass diterapkan pada timebar, panel, kontrol periode, serta progress bar waktu.
- `node --check js/game.js && node --check js/render.js && node --check js/data.js` berhasil.
- QA periode, skala ekonomi, save/load, migrasi save lama, dan geometri timebar pada 1280×800 serta 360×640 berhasil.
- Inspeksi visual setelah reload mengonfirmasi liquid glass dan progress bar tampil; geometri timebar tidak overflow pada desktop maupun mobile.

### Active
- Uji pacing dan kecepatan simulasi secara nyata di browser.
- Ambil/tinjau screenshot dengan game berjalan; screenshot terakhir membekukan game (`state.started=false`) agar progress 44% dapat diperiksa, sehingga area peta tampak kosong.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Uji perpindahan tick dan progress bar pada 1×/2×/3× saat simulasi benar-benar berjalan.
2. Ambil screenshot desktop/mobile tanpa membekukan game, lalu tinjau perubahan akhir dan status Git.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: simulasi waktu, pacing, HUD, save/load.
- `index.html`: markup timebar dan progress bar.
- `styles.css`: tema liquid glass dan layout responsif.
- `/tmp/opencode/qa-kotakita-stable.mjs`: QA periode, save/load, dan geometri layout.
- `/tmp/opencode/capture-kk.mjs`: skrip screenshot dan inspeksi visual; saat ini membekukan game untuk memeriksa progress.
- `/tmp/opencode/kk-desktop.png`: screenshot desktop terakhir, progress bar tampak tetapi peta kosong karena game dibekukan.
- `/tmp/opencode/kk-mobile.png`: screenshot mobile terakhir, timebar tidak overflow tetapi peta kosong karena game dibekukan.

## Important Context
- Perubahan belum dikomit. Git menunjukkan `README.md` berubah; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `js/`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, dan `styles.css` belum dilacak.
- `loop()` mengakumulasi `dt * state.speed`; progress waktu diatur lewat custom property `--time-progress`.
- QA periode dan save/load sudah berhasil, tetapi belum mengukur pacing aktual saat permainan berjalan.
